scenes.heading: Getting licensed, insured, and legally set up

sents.d: Getting licensed, insured, and legally set up
Proper setup protects you and builds customer trust from the start.

Requirements vary significantly by location and service type, but many local service businesses require some combination of a business license, liability insurance, and for certain trades, specific certifications or permits.

General liability insurance protects against claims of property damage or injury during a job, and is often required before certain platforms, referral networks, or commercial clients will work with you at all.

Checking with your local government's small business resources or a local business attorney early avoids the more costly problem of operating incorrectly for months before realizing a requirement was missed.

take: Confirm licenses and insurance with local resources early.
